question: Which paper reports the umber lattice coolant reversal result after microburst heating?
expected_answer_points: umber lattice coolant reverses heat buildup after microburst heating

candidate_papers.title: Umber lattice coolant reversal after microburst heating
candidate_papers.text: The umber lattice coolant reversal paper reports that the coolant reverses heat buildup after microburst heating and restores the lattice to baseline temperature.

candidate_papers.title: Preview of umber lattice coolant tests
candidate_papers.text: This near-duplicate preview uses the same umber lattice coolant and microburst heating language, but it only proposes reversal tests and reports no result.

candidate_papers.title: Umber lattice coolant warmup null study
candidate_papers.text: A gold-like null study of umber lattice coolant during microburst heating found ordinary warmup behavior and did not report heat buildup reversal.

candidate_papers.title: Sensor placement for microburst heating rigs
candidate_papers.text: The sensor placement note discusses microburst heating rigs and calibration, but contains no umber lattice coolant reversal evidence.

candidate_papers.title: Survey of lattice cooling vocabulary
candidate_papers.text: This survey repeats lattice cooling vocabulary and cites broad thermal control work without reporting the requested umber coolant microburst result.
